meta.source: device ToolRegistry (memory::registry) as advertised on an Orchestrator turn
meta.counted_from: lib/core + src/agent + src/main.cpp + src/sfx registration sites
meta.note: 49 statically-registered tools with SD present and a web-search key set. 10 are admin-only (dropped from a member/guest advertisement by toolSpecsFor). The synthetic terminal tool orch_turn and dynamic mcp.<slug>.<tool> connectors are added on the wire and are NOT in this catalog. core=curated target set; always=lazy always-on base.

tools.name: memory.write
tools.description: Save a durable fact or user preference to long-term memory.

tools.name: memory.search
tools.description: Search long-term memory for saved facts relevant to a query.

tools.name: memory.update
tools.description: Correct or update a fact already saved in long-term memory.

tools.name: memory.pin
tools.description: Pin a memory so it is always kept and never evicted.

tools.name: memory.config
tools.description: Read or change the memory engine configuration.

tools.name: memory.scratchpad

tools.name: memory.episodic
